selection_rule: Run A, B, C in preregistered order. Select the first configuration whose independent evaluation satisfies every frozen virtual accuracy, source, no-contact, FCL, timing and process gate. Run D only as an exact fresh-process repeat of that selected configuration. If no A-C cell is eligible, D is not executed.

V10-D.selection_precondition: selected A-C cell independently passes all frozen gates

physical_approach.reason: R10 physical HOME-to-Cube approach is out of scope
